blocks.text: What is IoT SCADA for solar power plants?

SCADA stands for supervisory control and data acquisition. EnerMAN’s IoT SCADA collects inverter-level, string-level and meter-level data from the plant through the ETi-LOG datalogger and presents it on ETi-SOL, a cloud platform, or ETi-EDGE, a local server, to monitor, control and analyse your solar PV assets (rooftop, utility to C&I) remotely and improve their performance. Alerts for faults or under-performance reach you as in-app notifications.
Does EnerMAN SCADA work with any inverter?

Yes. ETi-SOL is plug-n-play with any inverter. The ETi-LOG datalogger reads plant equipment over Modbus RTU/TCP, and ETi-SOL can use the existing hardware of a non-functional SCADA already present in the plant, so it suits retrofit as well as greenfield projects.
Can EnerMAN SCADA run on-premise, without the cloud?

Yes. ETi-EDGE is local monitoring software installed on a server at the plant. It collects data from the dataloggers connected to the plant equipment to monitor, control, analyse and report the plant’s performance. It works without internet, has no cloud storage charges, is a one-time investment and can still be reached remotely through web hosting. It is the option for government, SLDC or secured facilities and for plants with limited cloud connectivity.
How many solar plants does EnerMAN monitor?
EnerMAN’s platforms monitor 3+ GW of solar PV across 700+ plants for 300+ customers in 10+ countries, from rooftop and C&I sites to utility-scale plants.
Bring your solar plants to one screen.
